name: Moving-average undercut and rally

source.label: The moving-average undercut-and-rally setup of the Real Simple Strategy, with the 10/20-day EMA pullback of the Price Cycle Continuation strategy, both published in TradeZella's strategy library

rules: Only buy while the daily close is above a rising 50-day simple moving average (higher than it was 10 days earlier).
Buy when the daily close dips below the 10-day EMA and then closes back above it.
Sell on a daily close below the 20-day EMA, or at an 8% loss from the entry.
Hold one position per coin at a time.
notExpressed: The stop under the undercut swing low (a fixed 8% stands in for it)
Taking part of the position off after three to five strong days
Risking 0.5 to 1% of equity per trade, sized from the stop distance
Relative strength against the market and a strong sector or theme
The other setups on the source pages: episodic pivots on earnings gaps, flat-base and high-tight-flag breakouts, and the short side of the price cycle
Super Stock Momentum's version on the rising 50-day SMA (its 10-day trailing exit would fire on the bar after a 50-day reclaim)

variants.name: Sell on the first close below the 10-day EMA
